verdict.rationale: Exa documents background work it runs itself. The Exa Agent is an async research API, Websets results arrive asynchronously with HTTP webhook callbacks, and the pricing page lists 'Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web', which is a recurring automation rather than a one-off async job. However, the recurring-schedule capability appears only as a single pricing-page line, with no setup or configuration docs. Missing for 10: documented setup and configuration of scheduled/recurring automations (cadence, triggers, management), any detail beyond one pricing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web.
